schema.const: Bulk delete on production requires ?confirm=PRODUCTION parameter.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only tradeflows changed after this ISO 8601 timestamp (exclusive), with an offset. Without since, cursor, tradeflow or container: the last 15 minutes.

parameters.name: tradeflow
parameters.description: Your tradeflow reference. Returns that tradeflow regardless of when it changed.

parameters.name: container
parameters.description: A container number. Returns its tradeflows regardless of when they changed.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Keep only events of this category: MILESTONE, SHIPMENT or LOCATION.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Keep only events whose code starts with this value. One of: GE, GN, AE, VD, VA, UV, GT, GD, GR, POS, A-BKD, A-RCS, A-DEP, A-ARR, A-RCF, A-NFD, A-DLV. Any other value returns 400.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: next_cursor from the previous page. Keep since identical across the pages of one cycle.

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: true (active only), false, or both. Default: active plus recently deactivated.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated blocks: events, locations, containers, shipment, vessels. Default: all but vessels.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Shape of `events`: `v3` (Dockflow milestones) or `dcsa-tnt-2.2` (DCSA Track & Trace 2.2). The rest of the record is identical.

parameters.name: failsafe
parameters.description: Set to 1 and Dockflow keeps your position per API key and filter set, so repeated identical polls skip nothing.

200.description:
A page of tradeflows matching the filters. Pass `next_cursor` back to read
the next page; it is null on the last one.

anyOf.const: category must be one of: MILESTONE, SHIPMENT, LOCATION
since must be a valid ISO8601 timestamp

DownstreamTradeflow.description: A tradeflow to create, or to update when its tradeflow_reference already exists.

tradeflow_reference.description: Your unique reference for the tradeflow, for example a purchase order number.

container_reference.description: Container numbers (ISO 6346), as a string, an array of strings, or objects with custom properties.

custom_properties.description: Free-form key-value pairs stored on the container.

container_references_complete.description: When true, containers not listed are removed from the tradeflow. When omitted, the list is merged.

bill_of_lading_reference.description: Bill of lading number, with the carrier prefix, as a string or an array.

bill_of_lading_references_complete.description: When true, bills of lading not listed are removed.

booking_reference.description: Booking number, as a string or an array.

booking_references_complete.description: When true, bookings not listed are removed.

active.description: Set to false to deactivate the tradeflow.

carrier_scac.description: Carrier SCAC. A hint for which carrier to ask first; other carriers are still tried.

customer_name.description: Adds one partner with the role customer.

reference.description: The partner's own reference for this tradeflow.

lead_contact.description: Email or full name of an existing user at the partner.

partners_complete.description: When true, partners not listed are removed.

team_name.description: Name of an existing team. Ignored when no team matches.

lead_contact.description: Email or full name of an existing user in your organisation. Ignored when no user matches.

events.description: Your own events on the tradeflow.

location_name.description: 5-character UN/LOCODE; any other value leaves the event without a location.

actual.description: Whether the event already happened (true) or is planned (false).

free_time_overrides.description: Free-time overrides, upserted per scope. Unlisted scopes are untouched.

container_reference.description: Scopes the override to one container. Absent means tradeflow-wide.

custom_references.description: Flat key-value pairs you define. Values are stored as text; null or an empty string removes the key.

mock_tracking.description: UAT only: generates a synthetic journey. Ignored in production.
